 Our market leading products use cutting edge cloud\-based technology to streamline school processes, including secure web and mobile apps that enable secure online payments for school items such as meals, trips, clubs and uniform, improve parental engagement, simplify meal management and \- through our product SIMS \- collect and manage a database of student information and core school operations.

 Our bright team FastTrack their career with international exposure and ways of working based on agile development best practices from globally renowned technology consultancies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Software Development** 
 : design, code, test, and debug software solutions in accordance with project specifications. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
   

**Coding and Documentation:** 
 write clean, efficient, and well\-documented code. Maintain comprehensive documentation for code and software features.
   

**Front end web development** 
 : ability to design, create and evolve user\-facing applications to be scalable, maintainable, secure, aesthetic and usable within the constraints imposed by the browser using a combination of languages, design skills, and client\-side scripts and frameworks.
   

**Backend development** 
 : ability to write, maintain and design the business logic of a software application, the data or services requested are available as well as create and maintain the core databases, data and application program interfaces (APIs) to other backend processes.
   

**Database Management** 
 : knowledge of database systems (e.g. SQL Server, Oracle). Competence in writing and optimizing SQL queries.
   

**Version Control** 
 : proficient in using the Git version control systems.
   

**Testing and Debugging** 
 : experience with testing frameworks (e.g. XUnit) and debugging tools.
   

 Knowledge of test\-driven development (TDD) principles.
   

**DevOps** 
 : basic understanding of DevOps practices, continuous integration, and deployment.
   

**Cloud Computing** 
 : familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
   

**Collaboration:** 
 work closely with team members to understand project requirements and collaborate on project goals. Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to coding standards.
   

**Adaptability** 
 : stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends. Adapt to new tools, languages, and methodologies as required by projects.
   

**Quality Assurance:** 
 implement coding standards to ensure high\-quality, bug\-free code.
   

**Development Principles** 
 : implement industry standard development principles and frameworks for achieving quality, speed and maintainability. This includes the practices, techniques and tools that support those principles, and an understanding of when things may or may not be applicable in a situation or context.
   

**Giving and Receiving Feedback** 
 : solicit and engage with feedback on a continuous basis. Having timely, actionable and meaningful conversations about quality and performance for the purpose of improving effectiveness.
   

**Emotional Intelligence** 
 : recognizes, understands and manages their own emotions and recognizes, understands, shares and influences the emotions of others. Collaboration: works jointly with others to co\-create and achieve a common goal. This includes learning, practising and experimenting with tools, techniques and frameworks that foster collaborative working environments.
   

**Ownership and Accountability** 
 : takes personal accountability and ownership for their work. This includes personal follow through, making and defending difficult decisions and tradeoffs, removing blockers, driving collective progress.
   

**Continuous Improvement** 
 : advances by ongoing, incremental improvement through continuous learning, questioning the status quo and trying out creative and novel ideas. Shows curiosity and has a keen interest to drive learning for themselves and others.
   

**Systems Thinking** 
 : Positively impact complex systems or domains by understanding the whole picture and the interdependencies of its component parts. Maintain strong expertise and knowledge of current and emerging technologies and products.
   

  

  

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
 • Communication skills (both written and verbal) demonstrated at all levels of the organisation
   

 • Software development skills (.NET Framework, .NET Core, C\#, VB.Net, React, MVC, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, Xamarin, Java / XCode)
   

 • Cloud computing, particularly Microsoft Azure, with experience of deploying and managing applications in the cloud
   

 • RESTful API development
   

 • Testing framework knowledge (XUnit, Moq) and test driven development experience
   

 • Experience of source code control and release management (CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps)
   

 • Knowledge of API testing (Postman).
   

 • Database management, extensive query skills and ORM (Entity Framework) experience
   

 • Agile development methodologies: Kanban, Scrum, XP, Lean.

title: Director of Engineering Consumer Experience - Web & Mobile
description:
SPEED \& SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
   

  

**YOUR MISSION:**
 As Director of Engineering \- Consumer Experience, you'll lead the technology organisation responsible for delivering exceptional digital experiences across Web and Mobile platforms. This is a horizontal, platform\-level leadership role that sets the engineering direction, standards, and quality bar across every consumer\-facing product in our Direct\-to\-Consumer (DTC) business.
   

  

 You'll own the engineering foundation that product teams build upon \- shared platform capabilities, AI\-native tooling, frontend standards, and delivery infrastructure \- and lead a lean team of senior engineers and a network of delivery partners to build fast, accessible, AI\-native experiences that delight our consumers. You'll hold platform adoption authority and co\-own the engineering quality bar across the organisation.
   

  

 As PUMA continues to scale its DTC Engineering organization, our leaders are expected to be visible culture builders. These roles are office\-based and require regular in\-person collaboration to accelerate decision\-making, strengthen team cohesion, foster innovation, and build a world\-class engineering capability from the ground up.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities \& Scope of Ownership:**
**Technology Vision \& Strategy**
* Define and drive the multi\-year Consumer Experience technology vision, ensuring alignment with DTC business goals and emerging digital trends.
* Build and communicate a clear technology roadmap covering Web (desktop, PWA) and Native Mobile (iOS, Android) platforms.
* Champion AI\-native engineering paradigm \- from AI\-assisted development workflows to front\-end personalisation and intelligent UX embedded into the engineering culture from day one.
* Evaluate, select, and govern the technology stack (ReactJS, GraphQL, and emerging tools) to ensure longevity, performance, and developer productivity.


**Standards, Governance \& Engineering Excellence**
* Establish and enforce engineering standards, coding practices, design systems, accessibility guidelines (WCAG), and performance benchmarks across all consumer\-facing touchpoints.
* Build and own a component library and design system that enables velocity and consistency for all product teams.
* Define governance frameworks for third\-party vendor engagement including contracts, code quality reviews, delivery cadence, and SLA management.
* Introduce and maintain observability, performance monitoring, and incident management practices for consumer\-facing platforms.


**UI/UX \& Consumer Experience Leadership**
* Partner closely with UX/Design, Product, and Marketing teams to translate consumer insights into technically excellent digital experiences.
* Own the front\-end architecture for responsive, performant, and accessible web experiences and mobile applications.
* Drive adoption of modern UX engineering practices such as skeleton screens, optimistic UI, progressive enhancement, micro\-interactions.
* Champion performance engineering \- page load, rendering optimisation, image delivery, CDN strategy, and headless CMS integration via Sanity.


**Team \& Vendor Leadership**
* Lead, mentor, and grow a lean team of senior engineers while maintaining a high\-trust, high\-performance culture.
* Manage and hold accountable delivery partners for quality, timelines, and engineering standards.
* Partner with Engineering Heads, Product Owners and peer Directors to ensure horizontal services (design systems, shared APIs, performance tooling) are adopted consistently.


**YOUR TALENT:**
**Key Requirements:**
* 15\+ years of progressive engineering experience, with 5\+ years in a senior engineering leadership role.
* Strong architectural and implementation experience in modern front\-end engineering: ReactJS, TypeScript, GraphQL (GQL), REST APIs.
* Demonstrable mobile architecture \& engineering experience across React Native or iOS (Swift)/Android (Kotlin).
* Track record of building and governing cross\-functional engineering platforms used by multiple product teams.
* Strong working knowledge of modern consumer web standards, specifically web performance (Core Web Vitals), WCAG 2\.1 compliance, and progressive web applications.
* Background in fashion, retail, or sports DTC commerce environments.
* Experience with composable/headless commerce architectures.
* Experience with CI/CD, feature flagging, A/B testing frameworks.
* Experience with Design Systems \& Shared UI Platforms is highly preferred.
* Experience in SFCC (Salesforce Commerce Cloud) storefront or equivalent will be a plus.
* Demonstrated adoption of AI\-assisted engineering practices across the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity, software quality and efficiency.


**Leadership Expectations:**
* At PUMA, Directors are expected to operate as enterprise leaders who shape strategy, build capability, and create an environment where teams can deliver exceptional outcomes at speed and scale. Successful leaders combine commercial acumen, technical excellence, and people leadership while embodying the mindset and behaviours that define PUMA's culture.


**Strategic Thinking \& Vision**
* Translate ambitious business goals into clear, executable technology strategies and roadmaps.
* Demonstrate the courage to challenge conventional thinking and advocate for innovative solutions that create long\-term value.
* Operate effectively in ambiguity, providing clarity, direction, and confidence for teams and stakeholders.
* Balance immediate business priorities with long\-term scalability, sustainability, and consumer impact.
* Ownership \& Accountability
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of outcomes, driving execution with determination and a strong focus on results.
* Set high standards for quality, reliability, and operational excellence while fostering a culture of accountability.
* Navigate setbacks and changing priorities with resilience, maintaining momentum through complexity and uncertainty.
* Make difficult decisions when required and stand behind them with conviction and integrity.


**People \& Team Leadership**
* Build, develop, and retain diverse, high\-performing teams capable of delivering at scale.
* Foster an environment of trust, inclusion, collaboration, and mutual respect where individuals can thrive.
* Create opportunities for learning, growth, and continuous development while empowering teams with autonomy and accountability.
* Celebrate successes, recognise contributions, and cultivate a culture where high performance and enjoyment go hand in hand.


**Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management**
* Build strong partnerships across Product, Design, Data, Marketing, Operations, and Business teams to achieve shared outcomes.
* Influence effectively across all levels of the organisation through credibility, transparency, and strong communication.
* Demonstrate confidence in decision\-making while remaining open to challenge, feedback, and diverse perspectives.
* Lead with a team\-first mindset, breaking down silos and enabling collaboration across functions and geographies.


**Innovation \& Continuous Learning**
* Champion modern engineering practices, AI\-native ways of working, and a culture of experimentation.
* Encourage curiosity, learning, and thoughtful risk\-taking to unlock new opportunities for consumers and the business.
* Create space for innovation while maintaining a disciplined approach to execution and delivery.
* Continuously raise the bar on engineering excellence, operational maturity, and consumer experience.


**Commercial \& Consumer Mindset**
* Understand the connection between technology decisions, consumer experience, and business performance.
* Make decisions that balance innovation, speed, quality, and commercial impact.
* Maintain a strong consumer\-first perspective, ensuring technology investments create meaningful value for consumers.
* Demonstrate sound judgment and confidence when translating business priorities into engineering outcomes.


**Building PUMA's Future**
* Act as a visible culture builder and role model as PUMA continues to scale its DTC Engineering organisation.
* Embrace the opportunity to build teams, capabilities, and ways of working from the ground up.
* Lead with energy, optimism, and purpose, inspiring others to contribute to a shared vision and ambitious goals.
* Foster an environment where bold thinking, determination, collaboration, and enjoyment are all essential ingredients of success.


 PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.
   

  

 At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people \-with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.
   

  

 PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120\+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Mobile) - CONSUMER EXPERIENCE ENGINEERING
description:
SPEED \& SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
   

  

**YOUR MISSION:**
**About the Organisation \& Role:**
 You will be part of the Consumer Experience Engineering organisation responsible for building fast, intuitive, accessible and premium digital experiences across web and mobile. The organisation owns the web \& mobile platforms, engineering delivery for consumer\-facing journeys, shared design systems, performance, accessibility and AI\-native engineering practices that help product teams deliver consistent, reusable, high\-quality consumer experiences across the globe.
   

  

 The Senior Software Engineer (Mobile) is responsible for designing, building, optimizing, and supporting scalable consumer\-facing mobile applications while driving engineering excellence, architectural best practices, and operational reliability across iOS and Android platforms.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Design, build and maintain scalable mobile applications using React Native, TypeScript and JavaScript.
* Develop native iOS and Android integrations to deliver seamless consumer experiences.
* Define and implement robust application architecture, state management and API integration patterns.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Design, QA and Engineering teams to deliver high\-quality consumer\-facing solutions.
* Build secure, reliable and high\-performing mobile applications following engineering best practices.
* Develop reusable components, shared libraries and mobile engineering frameworks.
* Implement testing, code quality and automation practices across the development lifecycle.
* Monitor, troubleshoot and optimise application performance, stability and consumer experience.
* Contribute to App Store and Google Play releases, CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
* Drive engineering excellence through code reviews, technical mentoring and continuous improvement.
* Shape architecture decisions, produce technical documentation and maintain engineering standards within the team.
* Participate in Agile delivery activities including planning, estimation, refinement and retrospectives.
* Support experimentation, feature flagging and data\-driven product optimisation initiatives.


**YOUR TALENT:**
* 7\+ years of software engineering experience, including significant hands\-on experience building mobile applications.
* Strong hands\-on experience with React Native, TypeScript and modern JavaScript development.
* Solid understanding of iOS and Android platforms, application lifecycle and mobile platform capabilities.
* Experience developing and integrating native iOS and Android modules when required.
* Strong knowledge of mobile architecture patterns, modular design and scalable application development.
* Experience implementing state management solutions and application data flow patterns.
* Experience integrating mobile applications with REST and GraphQL APIs.
* Strong understanding of secure application development, authentication, data protection and consumer privacy practices.
* Experience building reusable components, shared libraries and maintainable mobile architectures.
* Strong experience with unit, integration and end\-to\-end testing, including test automation.
* Experience troubleshooting production issues, analysing crashes, monitoring application health and optimising performance.
* Knowledge of observability, logging, release management and operational support practices.
* Experience conducting code reviews, mentoring engineers and promoting engineering best practices.
* Understanding of accessibility standards, mobile accessibility practices, mobile UX principles and cross\-device compatibility.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication and collaboration skills.
* Experience in Consumer, Retail, eCommerce or DTC products is preferred.
* Experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging and A/B testing is a plus.
* Use AI\-assisted engineering tools and practices to improve development quality, delivery efficiency, testing and technical documentation.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.


 PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.

title: Android Lead
description:
**Job Requirements**
 At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 The Android Lead will lead the design, development, and evolution of the system Launcher on Android\-based platforms — spanning phones, tablets, and connected TV/STB devices. The role demands a deep mastery of AOSP internals, Jetpack Compose/Kotlin\-first UI architecture, and the unique performance, accessibility, and input\-model requirements of Android TV \& Google TV surfaces.
   

  

 The incumbent will serve as a technical authority across product, engineering, and platform teams — defining Launcher SDK contracts, driving architecture reviews, and mentoring a team of senior engineers across feature development, FOTA rollouts, and OEM customization layers.
   

  

**Android TV \& STB Platform Expertise**
* Architect TV Launcher experiences adhering to Google TV / Android TV UX guidelines, D\-pad navigation, leanback patterns, and Leanback/TV Compose APIs.
* Own focus management, spatial navigation engine, and D\-pad input routing across the Launcher surface.
* Design OEM\-specific overlay and customization frameworks for 4K, 2K STB SKUs.
* Collaborate with CMS and firmware teams on FOTA\-linked Launcher variant rollout strategies (phase\-based, suffix\-gated).


**Performance, Stability \& Observability**
 Define and own Launcher performance budgets: cold\-start, frame rendering (Janky Frames \<1%), TTID, memory headroom.
 - Drive crash/ANR telemetry analysis pipelines (Perfetto, ANR traces, tombstone parsing, SQLiteException correlation).

- Implement automated regression gates in CI for Launcher performance and stability.

- Architect proactive health dashboards integrating device telemetry, firmware version correlations, and user\-visible error rates.

**AI\-Enabled Launcher Features**
* Lead technical design for AI\-assisted launcher capabilities: semantic app search, contextual recommendations, proactive surfacing.
* Integrate on\-device ML models (TFLite, MediaPipe) for usage prediction and personalization without privacy compromise.
* Design integration points for agentic AI orchestration layers (e.g., JioCortex.AI\-style microservice mesh) within the Launcher context.


**Team Leadership \& Mentoring**
* Lead and mentor a team of 5–10 senior/mid\-level Android engineers across Launcher feature squads.
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and design critique sessions.
* Define engineering excellence standards: testing pyramid, CI/CD pipelines, and documentation norms.
* Partner with Product, CMS Ops, QA, and Firmware teams to drive end\-to\-end delivery.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills:** 
**DomRequired Skills \& Depth**
* Core Android: AOSP architecture, Launcher3, SystemUI, IPC (Binder/AIDL), WindowManager, ActivityTaskManager
* Kotlin / Jetpack: Kotlin Coroutines, Flow, Jetpack Compose, ViewModel, Hilt DI, Navigation, Room, DataStore
* Android TV / STB: Leanback Library, TV Compose, D\-pad/focus engine, Google TV UX guidelines, HDMI\-CEC, 4K rendering
* Performance: Perfetto, Systrace, Android Profiler, Janky Frames, TTID, memory analysis, GC tuning
* AI / ML Integration: TFLite, ML Kit, on\-device inference, recommendation pipelines, semantic search embedding
* Architecture: Clean Architecture, MVI/MVVM, modular Gradle, SDK design, API versioning, backward compat strategy
* Testing: JUnit5, Espresso, Robolectric, Compose UI testing, screenshot testing, CI/CD pipelines
* Languages: Kotlin (expert), Java (proficient), C/C\+\+ (working knowledge for NDK/HAL), Python (scripting)


**Experience Requirements**
* Total Android Engineering: 7–10 years
* AOSP Launcher / SystemUI: 5\+ years hands\-on AOSP development
* Android TV / CTV / STB: 4\+ years dedicated Android TV product delivery
* Jetpack Compose: 3\+ years production Compose (phone \+ TV surfaces)
* Technical Leadership: 3\+ years leading Architect or Principal\-level squads
* FOTA / OTA Systems: Experience with firmware lifecycle, phase rollouts, A/B OTA
* Performance Engineering: Demonstrable ownership of Launcher startup/frame budget


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior experience at OEMs (Samsung, OnePlus, Sony, Philips, TCL, Xiaomi) or telco device platforms (Reliance Jio, Airtel Xstream, Tata Play).
* Contributions to AOSP upstream (Gerrit patches, Launcher3 bug fixes, or CTS/VTS test additions).
* Experience with Google TV certification and GMS compliance processes.
* Familiarity with content delivery platforms, CMS\-driven UI personalization, and A/B feature experimentation on Android.
* Exposure to agentic AI platforms or LLM\-based feature integration on Android surfaces.
* Published technical talks, blog posts, or open\-source projects related to Android platform/Launcher engineering.
* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent. Advanced degree a plus.


 We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.
   

  

 We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference\-makers in our workplace.
